cases.name: shared_event_classifier
cases.expected: project and EventHandler::handles use the same pure classifier for Comments lifecycle events

cases.name: blog_post_target_filter
cases.expected: only Comments lifecycle events whose target_type is blog_post are projected

cases.name: created_deleted_delta
cases.expected: comment.created increments by one and comment.deleted decrements by one

cases.name: envelope_idempotency
cases.expected: the event envelope id is the delivery-ledger primary key and an existing delivery is acknowledged without another counter update

cases.name: atomic_counter_delivery_outbox
cases.expected: the optimistic counter update, delivery insert, and BlogPostUpdated outbox publication share one database transaction

cases.name: tenant_scoped_optimistic_update
cases.expected: the post lookup and update require tenant identity and the observed post version, with a bounded retry loop

cases.name: bounded_optimistic_retry_policy
cases.expected: the production loop uses one decision helper, applies after one updated row, retries seven zero-row results, and reaches its limit on the eighth

cases.name: postgres_retry_limit_rollback_and_replay
cases.expected: a PostgreSQL trigger skips eight real handler updates while a sequence counts each attempt; the terminal error leaves post, delivery, and outbox unchanged, and the same envelope succeeds after the trigger is removed

cases.name: missing_post_retry
cases.expected: a missing tenant post returns an error before the delivery marker is committed so the event runtime can retry

cases.name: non_negative_count
cases.expected: the pure counter transition floors deletes at zero and saturates count and version overflow

cases.name: host_registration_routing_harness
cases.expected: the retained module test invokes BlogModule::register_event_listeners, extracts one blog_comment_projection handler, accepts Blog comment created/deleted events, and rejects a non-Blog target

cases.name: postgres_event_dispatcher_delivery
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL dispatcher case registers the Blog handler through BlogModule, publishes one envelope through EventBus and EventDispatcher, then expects the counter, delivery ledger, and outbox row to commit

cases.name: postgres_concurrent_unique_deliveries
cases.expected: four handler instances start behind one barrier on four independent PostgreSQL connections, deliver unique envelopes to one post, and require count four, version five, four ledger rows, and four outbox rows without claiming observed retry count

cases.name: postgres_duplicate_delivery
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL target replays one envelope id and expects one counter transition, one delivery row, and one outbox row

cases.name: postgres_out_of_order_delete_create
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL target delivers delete before create and expects a non-negative count with monotonic versions

cases.name: postgres_missing_post_recovery
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL target expects no delivery or outbox commit while the post is missing, then replays the same envelope after source creation

cases.name: postgres_outbox_rollback_recovery
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL target removes the outbox table, expects counter and delivery rollback, recreates the table, and replays the same envelope

cases.name: postgres_restart_replay
cases.expected: the retained restart target opens a new database connection and handler over the same schema, replays the same envelope, and expects one durable application

cases.name: postgres_process_restart_replay
cases.expected: the retained process target launches the integration-test executable twice in sequence, reconstructs the same envelope id in each child process, and expects one counter transition, one delivery row, and one outbox row

cases.name: module_listener_registration
cases.expected: Blog registers BlogCommentProjectionHandler through the module event-listener registry

runtime_promotion_requirements: execute cargo test -p rustok-blog --lib services::comment_projection::tests and retain classifier, counter, and deterministic retry-policy output
execute the env-gated PostgreSQL dispatcher case and retain EventBus/EventDispatcher delivery output
execute the env-gated PostgreSQL concurrency case and retain four-connection convergence output
execute the env-gated PostgreSQL retry-limit case and retain its eight-attempt, rollback, and same-envelope recovery output
execute the env-gated PostgreSQL comment_projection_postgres_test target and retain its output
execute the env-gated same-process restart case and retain its output
execute the env-gated process-restart case and retain both child-process exits plus final durable assertions
retain proof that duplicate and out-of-order comment.created/comment.deleted deliveries match the source harness assertions
retain proof that the counter, delivery ledger, and BlogPostUpdated outbox row commit or roll back together
retain missing-post retry and later recovery evidence
retain naturally contended PostgreSQL retry-frequency evidence separately from the deterministic zero-row retry-limit harness
retain full server-host restart recovery evidence separately from the test-process harness
